---
title: "Where My Research Takes Me"
format: html
editor: visual
---
As an open-source GIS enthusiast, I thought it would be fun to create a map of all the places I have conducted research, as well as all of the places I have been fortunate enough to travel to for conferences, workshops, and colloquia.


```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(htmltools)

customIcons <- awesomeIcons(
  icon = "map-marker-alt",
  iconColor = "white",
  markerColor = "orange",
  library = "fa"
)

m <- leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap, group = "Topographic") %>%
  fitBounds(lng1 = -123.5, lat1 = -34.5, lng2 = 19.5, lat2 = 39) %>%

  # Add markers
  addAwesomeMarkers(
    lng = 18.861, lat = -33.986,
    popup = "Berg River, South Africa",
    label = "Berg River",
    icon = customIcons,
    group = "Sites"
  ) %>%
  addAwesomeMarkers(
    lng = 18.946042, lat = -33.977875,
    popup = "Eerste River Watershed, South Africa",
    label = "Eerste River",
    icon = customIcons,
    group = "Sites"
  ) %>%
  addAwesomeMarkers(
    lng = -120.366, lat = 37.243,
    popup = "Merced Vernal Pools and Grasslands Reserve, Merced, CA, USA",
    label = "Merced Vernal Pools",
    icon = customIcons,
    group = "Sites"
  ) %>%
  addAwesomeMarkers(
    lng = -121.175705, lat = 37.573927,
    popup = "Grayson Riverbend Preserve, Grayson, CA, USA",
    label = "Grayson Riverbend Preserve",
    icon = customIcons,
    group = "Sites"
  ) %>%
  addAwesomeMarkers(
    lng = -123.006, lat = 38.508,
    popup = "Russian River Watershed, CA, USA",
    label = "Russian River Watershed",
    icon = customIcons,
    group = "Sites"
  ) %>%
  addAwesomeMarkers(
    lng = -121.440734, lat = 38.265969,
    popup = "Cosumnes River Preserve, CA, USA",
    label = "Cosumnes River Preserve",
    icon = customIcons,
    group = "Sites"
  ) %>%

  # Add controls
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Satellite", "Topographic"),
    overlayGroups = c("Sites"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft") %>%
  addMiniMap(toggleDisplay = TRUE) %>%
  addLegend(position = "bottomright", colors = "orange", labels = "Research Sites", title = "Legend")

m

```
